resources.string: The quickest way to make payments from your Spark wallet.
It’s working—even when the camera stays out of sight.
%1$s scans in the background so checkout stays smooth. Aim at the code, wait a beat, and you’re ready.
Pay small amounts instantly with no extra taps.
Set a limit you’re comfortable with. For anything above it, %1$s asks before paying.
%1$s opens the wallet derived from your phrase.
The recovery phrase stays protected on this device while %1$s focuses on fast in-person payments.
Choose when %1$s should ask for confirmation before paying.

Using %1$s is at your own risk. This app can spend from the Spark wallet derived from your recovery phrase. You are fully responsible for the phrase, funds, and payments made.\n\nWe strongly recommend using a wallet with a small spending balance.
Have the recovery phrase for the wallet you want %1$s to use ready.
Open the wallet or backup where your recovery phrase is stored.
Enter the complete 12, 15, 18, 21, or 24-word phrase in %1$s.
%1$s opens that Spark wallet and protects the phrase with this device’s secure storage.
